title: BbY WOW
headline: Karol G cut this song from her album. Then she gave two singers a day to save it.
caption:
Karol G wanted the album to have an emotional song you could still dance to. Her pitch: "So, what happens when you're in the club and you're heartbroken? You just think about the other person, about the song you'd love to be dancing to with that person."

The beat underneath is the "Coolie Dance" riddim, created by Jamaican producer Cordel "Skatta" Burrell. He heard her version and said she "did a great job," calling it a "child of the 2000s."

The last-minute guests made history too. Judeline and Rusowsky became the first Spanish artists in the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 since Enrique Iglesias.

Is 'Bby Wow' a crying song or a dancing song for you?
